system.description: You hold the rig steady and give your crew the shot. Drive the rig up to its speed and test Agility (DR14). On a success, each ally aboard may use their reaction (↻) to make one attack against a creature within reach or range at any point along the way, without the penalty for attacking from a moving vehicle.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and their attacks have Boon.
outcomes.failure: The rig moves, but your crew get no clean shot.
outcomes.ruin: You lose control as on a driving test Failure.
